CustomField.formula: DATETIMEVALUE( TEXT( 2000 + VALUE(MID(DepartureDate__c, 5, 2)) ) & "-" & RIGHT("0" & TEXT(VALUE(MID(DepartureDate__c, 3, 2))), 2) & "-" & RIGHT("0" & TEXT(VALUE(MID(DepartureDate__c, 1, 2))), 2) & " " & LEFT(DepartureTime__c, 2) & ":" & RIGHT(DepartureTime__c, 2) & ":00" )
CustomField.label: 起飛日期(當地時間)
